title: Position, direction and turns
summary: Find left and right, above, below and between. Then turn an arrow a quarter, a half and three quarters of a turn.
guide: This studio is for Years 1 and 2. Read the sentences aloud; the small picture at the top also shows what to do.
Practise left and right with hands first: "Put your left hand up." The board is like a sheet of paper, so left is always on the child's left-hand side.

Clockwise is the way the hands of a clock go (↻); anticlockwise is the other way (↺). A quarter turn clockwise from facing forwards leaves you facing right. Two quarter turns make a half turn, and four make a whole turn, which brings you back to where you started.
Let your child turn too: stand facing the door, make a quarter turn clockwise, and say what you are facing now.

left-of.title: On the left
left-of.prompt: Tap the shape that is to the left of the blue circle.
left-of.hint: Put your left hand up. Find the shape on that side of the circle.
left-of.success: Well done! The orange triangle is to the left of the circle.
left-of.model: The green square is to the right of the circle, on my right-hand side. The triangle is on the left, and the circle is between the triangle and the square.

feedback.right-side: The green square is on your right-hand side. Put your left hand up and look that way.
feedback.itself: That is the circle itself. Tap the shape next to it on the left.
feedback.extra: Tap just one shape. Tap it again to take it off.

between.title: In between
between.prompt: The green square is above. The blue square is below. Drag the red square so it is between them.
between.hint: Between means in the middle of two things. Find the gap under the green square and over the blue square.
between.success: Well done! The red square is between the green and blue squares: below the green one and above the blue one.
between.why: Which square is the red square above now? Which is it below?
between.model: The red square is above the blue square and below the green square. That is why we say it is between them.

feedback.wrong-place: The red square is not between them yet. It must be just below the green square and just above the blue square.
feedback.swapped: The red square is not between them yet. It must be just below the green square and just above the blue square.

quarter-turn.title: A quarter turn
quarter-turn.prompt: The arrow points at the tree. Guess first: after a quarter turn clockwise, what will it point at? Now press ↻.
quarter-turn.hint: Clock hands go from the top towards the right. Press ↻ once.
quarter-turn.success: Well done! A quarter turn clockwise took the arrow from the tree to the house.
quarter-turn.why: What would the arrow point at after a quarter turn anticlockwise?
quarter-turn.model: The yellow box. Anticlockwise is the other way, from the top towards the left.

feedback.wrong-way: The arrow points at the yellow box. That was anticlockwise. Press Start again, then ↻.
feedback.long-way: The arrow points at the house, but you went the long way round. A quarter turn clockwise is just one ↻. Press Start again.
feedback.wrong-turn: The arrow is not pointing at the house. Press Start again and press ↻ just once.

half-turn.title: A half turn
half-turn.prompt: The arrow points at the tree. Turn it a half turn clockwise. A half turn is two quarter turns.
half-turn.success: Well done! After a half turn the arrow points at the ball, the opposite way.
half-turn.why: What happens if you make a half turn anticlockwise instead?
half-turn.model: It points at the ball too. A half turn either way faces the opposite way. Two half turns make a whole turn, and the arrow points at the tree again.

feedback.long-way: It points at the ball! A half turn either way gets there. But this time go clockwise: Start again, then ↻ twice.
feedback.wrong-way: The arrow is not pointing at the ball. Press ↻ twice.
feedback.wrong-turn: The arrow is not pointing at the ball. Press Start again and press ↻ twice: tree, house, ball.

three-quarter-turn.title: Three quarters of a turn
three-quarter-turn.prompt: The arrow points at the tree. Turn it three quarter turns anticlockwise. Guess first what it will point at.
three-quarter-turn.hint: Press ↺ three times and count: box, ball, …
three-quarter-turn.success: Well done! Three quarter turns anticlockwise: tree, box, ball, house.
three-quarter-turn.why: The arrow points at the house. A shorter turn would get there too. Which one?
three-quarter-turn.model: A quarter turn clockwise. Three quarters of a turn one way ends in the same place as a quarter turn the other way, because together they make a whole turn.

feedback.long-way: The arrow points at the house, but you made a quarter turn clockwise. This time go anticlockwise: Start again, then ↺ three times.
feedback.wrong-way: The arrow points at the yellow box. Three quarter turns anticlockwise go tree, box, ball, house. Press Start again, then ↺ three times.
feedback.wrong-turn: That is not three quarter turns yet. Press Start again and press ↺ three times.
